original_requirement: Observe the production planning-adaptation Whole strict-tool boundary and output-budget lineage without changing provider requests, prompts, contracts, acceptance, retry, fallback, budgets, checkpoints, or formal artifacts; derive only an offline one-variable retained-budget counterfactual and non-executable Canary contracts.
operational_definition: The closed target is review/planning_adaptation_whole_receipt/planning_adaptation_whole@1/configured_fallback plus the minimum parent budget lineage. Success means request, provider-raw, adapter-normalized and gateway decision hashes correlate; missing snapshots remain unknown; all diagnostics fail open; current business outputs and incident classification remain identical.
forbidden_narrowing: A normalized Gateway response alone cannot be presented as provider-raw evidence.
A missing or partial snapshot cannot be classified as zero tool calls.
Parser or boundary recovery cannot be presented as workflow recovery.
The offline counterfactual cannot be presented as a production behavior fix or proof that Whole fallback would be avoided.
Passing deterministic adapters cannot be presented as real-provider shape evidence.
Canary A and Canary B cannot share approval, cohort, launcher, fingerprint, or execution.
closed_world_justification: The user explicitly limited full-shape collection to one controlled stage/boundary/contract/role/route tuple. is_strict_tool_target performs equality checks over that tuple and tests count non-target strict routes without persisting full shape.

constraint_traceability.evidence: Production-adapter fake transports reach the real adapters and Gateway and assert one exact correlation across all three layers.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Preserve original exception identity, traceback, cause/context, fallback classification and production incident family.
constraint_traceability.implementation: Adapter snapshots attach to the original exception object; observers swallow sink/serialization failures and never wrap exceptions.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Enabled/disabled runs compare object identity, type, message, traceback frame names, cause/context, model failure classification and production incident classification; forced sink failure preserves the business exception and call count.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Store no prompt, prose, raw response, argument, credential, request ID, absolute path, or unknown tool name in cleartext.

constraint_traceability.requirement: Keep both diagnostic flags default-off and execution-fingerprint-visible without changing build fingerprint.
constraint_traceability.implementation: runtime_fingerprint.py registers both flags; model_diagnostics.py checks exact value 1 at the observation boundary.
constraint_traceability.evidence: Tests prove defaults are false, build fingerprint is stable, and execution-config/runtime-execution fingerprints change when flags change.

projected_failure_mechanisms: provider returns zero, wrong, multiple or partial tool calls
adapter drops or duplicates a provider tool call
adapter raises while decoding malformed arguments
output expansion is computed inside a runtime then lost when an outer retry reconstructs it
provider/model/canary caps reduce an expansion target
diagnostic serialization, lock or append failure masks a business exception
model_output_not_applicable_evidence: No parser, normalizer, schema, ToolCall conversion, strict uniqueness condition, accepted value, retry/fallback count, request body, Prompt, Contract, or budget assignment is changed. The only new adapter result is sanitized side-channel metadata in existing provider_state or on the original exception, and enabled/disabled production-shaped tests assert identical business decisions.
why_previous_tests_missed: Earlier tests started at normalized ModelResponse or Contract Runtime output and therefore could not distinguish provider absence from adapter loss/duplication, nor show that each outer Whole attempt rebuilt a runtime after computing an unused expansion. R1-PA1 crosses the real adapter and next Gateway boundary with fake transports and records runtime-instance lineage.
